text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not "aggro," but "control"! Not "aggro," 
but "control"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... How was that... for a 
pace, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that lap was just as calculated!

Yeah, that lap was right on calculated 
pace!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright... Then, let's settle into this 
pace.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who excel at starts are like— in 
card game terms— an aggro deck that 
attacks from the opening turn.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If we compete with the same tactic, I'll 
be at a disadvantage with my poor starts. 
In that case, I will—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll go with a control deck strong in the 
mid-to-late game. To make up for a late 
start, I'll take control of the race pace.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: This is how a true gamer fights.
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's uniquely us, isn't it!

text_block_list.text:
It seemed like a pretty solid strategy. If 
she can control the pace well... it'll 
give her a huge advantage.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this plan alone isn't enough. If I 
want to ensure perfection..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I need to read the atmosphere of the main 
event and figure out which Umamusume will 
gain the biggest edge from it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With what mindset each of them will 
approach it, and who the most dangerous 
opponent will be...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I have to shut down their chance of 
winning.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Who is it—the Umamusume closest to victory 
in the Nippon Derby?

Rulership seemed to be frantically 
searching for the one person she needed to 
keep an eye on.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to lose. Not when I must 
avenge the honor of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I shall strike even deeper roots into 
this soil and forge a glorious 
thousand-year kingdom."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to win... and expand our circle. 
Endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to connect people with a circle of 
hope. No matter what."

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's with this crowd?! Was the 
Race Cafe always this packed?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
For this upcoming Tokyo Yushun, the full 
lineup is as stacked as it could possibly 
get!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, who do you think's gonna win the 
next race? People are getting super hyped 
up for it.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Were you ever even interested in 
Umamusume races?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The drive of the participating Umamusume 
and the excitement of the fans grow 
stronger day by day!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who started calling it this, 
but this year's Derby has been given a 
title.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: As the "greatest Derby in history"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The greatest Derby in history... Facing 
unprecedented excitement—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume's sense of rivalry has 
heightened to the extreme. —Sparks are 
flying aggressively.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The question is how this state of mind 
will affect the board... There are two 
possibilities――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ah, in other words—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Either 'all out from the start' or 
'jockeying for position.'"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"'Going all out from the start.' If it 
turns out to be this pattern—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It turns into a brutal war of attrition 
right from the start, causing the 
front-runners to completely collapse in 
the end.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“Checking each other.” On the other hand, 
if that's the pattern we end up in—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Due to mutual caution, the pace slowed to 
an extreme crawl, turning the final 
straight into a wall-to-wall showdown.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
In that case, Trainer. What type of 
Umamusume would have the advantage?

It is already decided. Whether the front 
collapses completely, or it comes down to 
an all-out sprint from the get-go, the one 
with the advantage will be...
choice_data_list:
She's an Uma Musume with a sharp finishing 
kick...

An Uma Musume with a sharp finishing 
kick...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Exactly. Out of all the players, 
who has the sharpest late burst...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There are many from her class. Among 
them—the most promising is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Uncover the records etched upon the 
board... Holding the 'Flash of Late Speed' 
card in secret...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(The Umamusume who's about to play her 
trump card in this big race is...)
toi,toi,toi……――

—34.4 seconds. It isn't an exceptional 
time, but— it's right on schedule.

—33.9 seconds. I've finally... cleared the 
first hurdle...

—33.0 seconds. Just a bit more—until I 
break through.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A certain number... that has continually 
been broken.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Which means that...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: âI see it. Trainer, I finally see it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ever since her debut, there's been an 
Umamusume who has steadily continued to 
hone her late-race sprint.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
True to his name—with a "flash" of a late 
charge.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This enigmatic 'Japanese Derby'. The 
rival standing before me is likely—that 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Taking all that into account... Is there 
any way to keep the pace from becoming 
abnormally fast or painfully slow?
choice_data_list:
At this rate, will I not be able to 
control it?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone's getting way too heated 
up. In this state, they're completely out 
of control.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If most of the Umamusume were just 
marking me, we'd be fine, but Rose and 
Pisa are in the mix too."

What we need is... an additional strategy. 
Let's think of it in terms of a board 
game.

There are plenty of strategies besides a 
frontal assault. Ambushing, negotiating, 
and creating diversions...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm? A diversion...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I see. Diversions by other units can be 
carried out before the race, then.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Stand out beforehand to make them wary and 
think, 'We can't leave him unchecked!', 
then make them dance to my pace during the 
real deal. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With so many eye-catching Umamusume 
around, how can I draw people's attention 
without being outshined...?

"A way to catch people's eyes... The idea 
that vaguely came to mind was..."
choice_data_list:
Like making some bombshell statement to 
the media or something?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A bombshell statement, huh? But there's no 
bombshell statement I could possibly 
make...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No... there is... there was one... It's 
not quite a bombshell, but if I say this, 
it'll stand out insanely well."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I really don't want to say 
this. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Are we... doing it...? I'd rather not, if 
possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even so—if it means seizing the initiative 
at the Japanese Derby!

"And a few days later, Rulership made a 
preemptive strike on a TV show."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It seems everyone has the wrong idea. 
Thinking the ones to look out for in the 
Japan Derby are Rose or Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, that double bind is a mistake. 
The one you should be marking is me, 
Rulership. Because I am—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
She is, after all, the beloved disciple of 
the great Air Groove-san. And—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I was entrusted with something in hopes 
of certain victory. And that is this—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A horseshoe statue commemorating victory 
in the Oaks.
(Oooohh...!?)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san's mother, Air Groove-san 
herself, and then me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Winning a 2400m GI in the Classic Year is 
a mission assigned to our school.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Of course, along with the horseshoe 
statue, I was also given a surefire 
winning strategy that only an experienced 
runner could provide.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A jolt of electricity ran down my spine 
when I heard that plan. To think someone 
could interpret a race like that...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If they let me run completely unmarked, 
it's gonna be an easy win.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove? Did you... teach Ruler-chan 
something?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, besides, there is no such thing as a 
horseshoe statue to commemorate a victory 
in the Oaks. Mother, surely you know that 
as well?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Let me say it once more. I am Air 
Groove-san's beloved pupil."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A word of advice. Anyone who wants to win 
better keep their eyes glued to me.
And after filming wrapped up...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, I actually said ittt~!! No matter 
how you look at it, that's way too 
crazzzyyy~!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I know I'm the one who came up with it, 
but... that seriously took years off my 
life...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Man, what's she gonna say to me later...? 
Lectures, scolding, and on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If you're my beloved disciple, come to 
the academy more often!" ...Or something 
like that, before I get dragged off~~~.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Well... I guess so.

The show received a massive response. 
Rulership definitely caught the public's 
eye.

In other words, even the gazes of our 
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Losing that was huge. But with this... the 
number of Umamusume keeping an eye on me 
will definitely go up.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, racecraft is simple. 
I won't let it become a simple contest of 
closing speed."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you. Being an Umamusume isn't 
just about going with the flow and 
running.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Create the flow you desire, and move 
everyone around you at will. That is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This is our way of fighting. Just watch, 
the ones who will dominate the greatest 
Derby in history are—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's not a flash of lightning—it's a 
strategy!
